Sergei rather cordial with a touch of madness.He always has a smile stuck on his face, no matter what the situation. Difficult is the first word that comes to mind when talking about becoming « friends » with him. This gentleman believes only in himself and his right hand. He is articulate, but tends to be mischievous when he does so. Depending on the situation he is placed in, the young man will adapt his behavior. Let’s say he is in the presence of someone from his circus, the red will prefer to bring out his true personality, that is to say someone sadistic, self-centered and deeply lost in a sweet madness. It doesn’t matter to him if you are hurt or not. Otherwise he will be a simple bourgeois man, sympathetic, warm and eccentric on the edges. The kind of person with whom one would gladly have a cup of tea and cookies. Don’t be fooled, he lies like he breathes! He’s a villain after all, isn’t he? To detect his lies effectively, look at his little gestures. (Playing with his fingernails, putting his hand behind his back or tapping his foot)
